initialPrompts:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE exceptionally polished website design presentation board for DIET CODE, a creative engineering studio. This is Direction 01: LOUD PRINT. Output a crisp large landscape presentation, roughly 2400x1900 pixels, with REAL legible finished UI, not a moodboard, not a photo of a screen. The underlying site is a studio portfolio, never a soda store.

BOARD STRUCTURE: neutral pale gray outer margin, small black title top left "01 / LOUD PRINT". Main upper area contains a large flat desktop website screenshot with 1440:900 proportions occupying 75% width, and a flat narrow 390:844 mobile screenshot at right occupying 20% width. No device frames, no perspective, no drop-shadow browser windows. Under that, a clearly labeled "PAGE FLOW" row of three miniature complete subsequent website sections at left, and a labeled "STOP-MOTION / 8 FPS" storyboard of four bottle poses at right. Grid-aligned, intentional gaps, expensive art-direction presentation.

DESKTOP HERO: acid chartreuse green #D9FF43 flat paper ground, rich black ink #101110, warm cream #F4F1EA details. A bold black 3px rectangular border enclosing the composition. Small Diet Code wordmark in bold condensed grotesque at upper left, compact plain nav "Capabilities" "Studio" and black rectangular "Start a project ↗" button at right. Huge radically condensed black heavyweight typography anchored left and taking about 55% of hero: "CREATIVE" on first line, "ENGINEERING." on second and third as needed, fully readable and never arbitrarily clipped. Beneath, quiet 22px plain serif-free copy: "WebGL, audio systems and full-stack builds." One hard-edged black action "View capabilities ↓". Right side: an enormous actual photographic green glass soda bottle, standing at a confident 7-degree angle, with a tactile uneven off-white cut-paper silhouette border. Smooth real glass, NOT voxels or illustration. Small green cap, condensation, dark emerald liquid with visible clear air space. Broad off-white bottle label with vintage slanted green "diet code" and a green wave underline. Bottle is printed as a green-and-black coarse 45-degree AM halftone photograph with deliberate tiny misregistration and realistic paper fibers. It commands attention, is fully within the hero, and never blocks necessary UI. One tight hard-offset black paper shadow. Halftone texture stays INSIDE the bottle photograph, with only extremely subtle paper grain on flat green ground. Do NOT cover the entire background in polka dots. Lower edge has three simple type-only capability links separated by black rules: "WebGL" / "Audio & DSP" / "Full-stack & AI". No invented clients or fake awards or performance stats.

MOBILE: same green hero art direction; compact wordmark and Menu; headline reflows "CREATIVE / ENGINEERING." in large condensed type, then a large bottle cutout about 40% of viewport height centered, short studio descriptor, full-width black "Start a project ↗" button. Clear margins, readable text, no overlaps.

PAGE FLOW MINIATURES: 1 off-white capability specimen screen with huge "WebGL" title left and one black/green printed abstract 3D specimen right, no pretend client projects; 2 black studio screen with huge cream "Three people. Diet Code." and names "Gowrish / Jeswin / Sabi" in ruled rows; 3 chartreuse contact close "START A PROJECT" with a simple project enquiry area. Show layouts, not only labels. Keep bottle confined to hero so page has variety.

STORYBOARD: same isolated bottle cutout in four separate clean frames: capped upright / a slight squash and rotation / cap airborne with two small fizz marks / bottle settled. Labels "01 Rest" "02 Nudge" "03 Pop" "04 Settle". Stop-motion is stepped paper replacement, no smooth 3D-spin look.
STYLE: premium contemporary independent creative studio, punk print confidence controlled by Swiss alignment. Maximum one main bottle and one print-texture motif in hero. No collage of eyes, hands, stickers, stars, smileys, retro computer windows, comic bursts or vending machines. No gradients or rounded SaaS cards. Brand must read Diet Code, NEVER Diet Codebase.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE exceptionally polished website design presentation board for DIET CODE, a creative engineering studio. This is Direction 02: STUDIO INDEX. Output a crisp large landscape presentation, roughly 2400x1900 pixels, with REAL legible finished UI, not a moodboard, not a photo of a screen. The site offers creative engineering services, never beverage sales.

BOARD STRUCTURE: neutral pale gray outer margin, small black title top left "02 / STUDIO INDEX". Main upper area: a large flat desktop website screenshot in 1440:900 proportions occupying 75% width; at right a flat 390:844 mobile screenshot occupying 20%. No device frames or perspective. Under that, labeled "PAGE FLOW" row with three miniature complete subsequent website screens at left, and "STOP-MOTION / 6 FPS" four-frame bottle storyboard at right. Precise clean presentation grid.

DESKTOP HERO: warm off-white #F4F1EA, near-black ink #0E0E10, ultramarine cobalt #1E48FF only on functional borders, navigation and active state. Photographic emerald bottle provides a separate natural green. Restrained neobrutalist editorial design like a contemporary printed architecture journal, with visible straight 2px ink/cobalt rules. NOT a giant slogan with bottle to the right. Upper masthead "DIET CODE" in huge wide near-black grotesque across almost all screen width, about 180px tall, with a fine black horizontal rule under. Above that small utility navigation: left "Independent creative engineering studio", right "Studio" and "Start a project ↗". Below masthead use a deliberate three-column editorial composition: narrow left column with a prominent heading "The practice" and three large numbered rows "01 WebGL" "02 Audio & DSP" "03 Full-stack & AI", the middle row active with a solid COBALT background and off-white text. Center column is the most graphic: a life-size photographic green glass soda bottle in a vertical clean paper-cut silhouette, shot directly front on; white irregular cut edge, coarse black/green AM halftone texture, vintage slanted green "diet code" label with wave underline, real reflective glass, condensation, clear air space and green cap. Smooth glass not voxel, not illustration. Bottle stands on a thin black baseline, and its cap is slightly separated vertically to suggest stop motion. The column remains plain paper; no photo rectangle, no background doodles, no oversized UI cards. Right column has a thoughtful concise intro set in around 38px grotesque on 5 lines "We build websites, instruments and systems." and below a short 18px sentence "A small studio working across code, sound and interaction." One cobalt rectangular border button "View capabilities ↗". Bottom of hero has a thin cobalt rule and a small readable line "Gowrish · Jeswin · Sabi" left and "Diet Code" right. No location invented. Larger negative space than other directions, confidence from type scale and exact alignment. Make content visually balanced; each column earns its space.

MOBILE: same paper ground with a huge two-line "DIET / CODE" masthead, a thin cobalt rule, short "Creative engineering studio." description, three big vertically stacked numbered capability rows with "02 Audio & DSP" cobalt selected, then bottle cutout seated off to one side of the remaining area without obscuring text, and a full-width cobalt "Start a project ↗" button at bottom. Compose for touch with generous target sizes.

PAGE FLOW MINIATURES: 1 an editorial capability spread with huge "Audio & DSP" title and a single ink waveform print; 2 a quiet team page with a large typeset "The studio" and three long typographic name rows "Gowrish", "Jeswin", "Sabi", no invented headshots; 3 ultramarine full-bleed contact close with huge off-white "Let's make it." and a straight ruled "Start a project ↗" action. No fake project thumbnails.

STORYBOARD four separate frames of same bottle on plain paper, a capability index numeral changing next to it: bottle front / slightly turned printed side / back 3/4 / returns front with cap lifted. Labels "01 WebGL" "02 Audio" "03 Systems" "04 Open". The frame-to-frame photographs jump in small paper-registration offsets like analog contact sheets, never smooth CGI. Low motion and deliberate.
STYLE: luxury editorial restraint meets blunt functional brutalist typography. Text stays live-looking and perfectly legible. Two visual layers maximum. No collage, eyes, hands, stickers, starbursts, CRTs or vending machines. No rounded cards, gradients, fake awards, client logos or claims. Brand MUST be Diet Code, NEVER Diet Codebase.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE exceptionally polished website design presentation board for DIET CODE, a creative engineering studio. This is Direction 03: BOTTLE THEATRE. Output a crisp large landscape presentation, roughly 2400x1900 pixels, with REAL legible finished UI, not a moodboard or photo of a screen. Studio portfolio experience, never a store for soda.

BOARD STRUCTURE: pale gray neutral outer margin, small black title top left "03 / BOTTLE THEATRE". Upper area contains a large flat desktop website screenshot in 1440:900 proportions occupying 75% width, and a flat 390:844 mobile screenshot at right occupying 20%. No perspective or device mockups. Beneath: labeled "PAGE FLOW" row with three miniature full subsequent sections at left, and labeled "STOP-MOTION / 10 FPS" four-frame bottle sequence at right. Expensive grid-aligned design proposal, not a jumble.

DESKTOP HERO: full-bleed vivid vermilion crimson #E62E2D flat printed-paper stage, near-black ink #0E0E10, off-white #F4F1EA monumental typography, natural green photographic bottle. A 4px black border encloses the hero with a compact off-white header strip top: Diet Code wordmark left, "Capabilities" "Studio" and black square-edged "Start a project ↗" action right. Rest of hero is an immersive single stage. Giant condensed off-white display typography "DIET" upper left and "CODE" lower right; both words fully readable but one emerald bottle cutout occupies the central open diagonal between them. The bottle is deliberately diagonally pitched about 20 degrees, large enough to command half the stage and fully contained with comfortable margins. This is photographic green glass cut out of a printed magazine, smooth realistic glass not voxels, with a visible irregular cream cut-paper border, coarse 45-degree green/black halftone dots, ink misregistration and tactile glass highlights. Off-white label says vintage italic green "diet code" with green wave underline, cap caught popping 60px above mouth, three tiny photographic fizz droplets. Flat hard ink shadow offset subtly. Keep the composition clear: typography and cutout only, no confetti or comic background.

Lower left, one off-white rectangular panel integrated with the stage margin, not a floating rounded card: clear black heading "Creative engineering studio." and short descriptor "WebGL. Audio & DSP. Full-stack & AI." An underlined black action "View capabilities ↓". Lower right, a single simple black/cream interaction control strip with text "Pop the cap ↗" and a small square speaker toggle labeled "Sound off". Top right of red stage a small monospace "FRAME 01 / 04" marker. Design the stage like a tactile contemporary stop-motion film title sequence. No excessive controls, no entry gate or loading screen. Beautiful poised negative space, strong hierarchy, not circus clutter.

MOBILE: cream Diet Code nav and Menu on top, red stage with huge stacked cream "DIET / CODE", the same diagonal photographic green cutout bottle large in the central negative space. Short black-on-cream "Creative engineering studio." band above the bottom. A full-width black "Start a project ↗" button. Small touch-friendly "Pop the cap" button positioned below bottle and above descriptor, nothing covers body copy.

PAGE FLOW MINIATURES: 1 almost-black capability stage with huge cream "Code that moves." a green/cream abstract shader specimen and a plain "WebGL" link; 2 cream "Sound & systems" spread with two large ruled typographic entries "Audio & DSP" and "Full-stack & AI" and one black waveform image, no fake projects; 3 crimson contact close with monumental cream "YOUR NEXT / PROJECT." and a flat cream "Start a project ↗" action. The page alternates quiet content with one theatrical hero; do not repeat the bottle in every section.

STORYBOARD four separate frames of same printed bottle: upright capped / diagonal anticipation / cap off and tiny fizz droplets / settles into label-forward final pose. Labels "01 Hold" "02 Wind-up" "03 Pop" "04 Land". Changing stepped position and paper shadows suggest handmade stop motion; zero smooth 3D rotating render look.

STYLE: bold premium title-sequence direction, theatrical but disciplined modern neobrutalism and halftone print, typography and cutout only. No fake clients, awards, ratings or speed claims. No unrelated eyes, hands, stickers, rubberhose characters, stars, lightning, comic bursts, CRTs, vending machines, decorative icons, rounded SaaS cards or gradients. Brand MUST be Diet Code, NEVER Diet Codebase.

Do not crop the bottle. Keep it in the right column on desktop without blocking the heading or links. Keep mobile headline readable and bottle complete above descriptor and CTA. Do not turn it into an illustration or voxel object. Keep the bottle straight and calm in this editorial direction. 2. In the small 'The studio' page-flow panel preserve Gowrish, Jeswin and Sabi as large ruled name rows but REMOVE all the individual role descriptions, which are unconfirmed.
